source.query:
SELECT   
    toStartOfWeek(created_at) AS week,  
    count() AS tickets  
FROM zendesk_tickets  
WHERE   
    tags NOT LIKE '%community%'  
    AND tags NOT LIKE '%root_cause_autoresponse/spam%'  
    AND status != 'deleted'  
    AND zendesk_groups.name = 'Product Analytics'  
    AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH  
GROUP BY week  
ORDER BY week ASC

insight.name: Toast Errors
insight.derived_name: Dashboard Toasts count & Insight Toasts count

source.query:
SELECT 
    toStartOfWeek(created_at) AS week,
    CASE
        WHEN tags LIKE '%trends_insights%' THEN 'Trends Insights'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%funnels%' THEN 'Funnels'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%dashboards%' THEN 'Dashboards'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%sql_insights%' THEN 'SQL Insights'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%retention%' THEN 'Retention'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%cohorts%' THEN 'Cohorts'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%data_table%' OR tags LIKE '%product_analytics__data_table_insights%' THEN 'Data Tables'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%ingestion%' THEN 'Data Ingestion'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%persons%' THEN 'Persons'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%events%' THEN 'Events'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%paths%' THEN 'Paths'
        WHEN tags LIKE '%lifecycle%' THEN 'Lifecycle'
        ELSE 'General/Other'
    END AS feature_area,
    count() AS bug_count
FROM zendesk_tickets
WHERE 
    tags NOT LIKE '%community%'
    AND tags NOT LIKE '%root_cause_autoresponse/spam%'
    AND status != 'deleted'
    AND zendesk_groups.name = 'Product Analytics'
    AND (tags LIKE '%root_cause_incident%' OR tags LIKE '%root_cause_customer_error%')
    AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 6 MONTH
GROUP BY week, feature_area
ORDER BY week ASC, bug_count DESC
LIMIT 100

insight.name: Product Analytics - Bug Report types / month

source.query:
SELECT 
    formatDateTime(toStartOfMonth(created_at), '%Y-%m') AS month,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%trends_insights%') AS trends_insights,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%dashboards%') AS dashboards,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%persons%') AS persons,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%sql_insights%') AS sql_insights,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%ingestion%') AS data_ingestion,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%retention%') AS retention,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%funnels%') AS funnels,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%events%') AS events,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%paths%') AS paths,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%cohorts%') AS cohorts,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%data_table%' OR tags LIKE '%product_analytics__data_table_insights%') AS data_tables,
    countIf(tags LIKE '%lifecycle%') AS lifecycle,
    countIf(
        tags NOT LIKE '%trends_insights%' 
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%dashboards%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%persons%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%sql_insights%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%ingestion%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%retention%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%funnels%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%events%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%paths%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%cohorts%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%data_table%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%product_analytics__data_table_insights%'
        AND tags NOT LIKE '%lifecycle%'
    ) AS general_other
FROM zendesk_tickets
WHERE 
    tags NOT LIKE '%community%'
    AND tags NOT LIKE '%root_cause_autoresponse/spam%'
    AND status != 'deleted'
    AND zendesk_groups.name = 'Product Analytics'
    AND (tags LIKE '%root_cause_incident%' OR tags LIKE '%root_cause_customer_error%')
    AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MONTH
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month ASC
LIMIT 100

## Repeated values across properties

Query kind names repeat under `query_type` (tiles above) and `kind`; `true`/`false` repeat under `cache_hit` and `retried`. Each value keeps one color across tiles.

insight.name: Query failures by kind
insight.description: `kind` re-uses the query type names — its values should copy the query_type tile colors, incl. a pinned one.

insight.name: Query volume by cache hit
insight.description: true/false under `cache_hit` — on one tile per property, they only qualify for a dashboard color counted across properties.

insight.name: Request failures by retried
insight.description: true/false under `retried`, mirroring the cache-hit tile.
